note: Rust-side observability: new opt-in tracing feature (vespera/tracing, forwarded to vespera_inprocess/tracing). Every in-process / JNI dispatch runs inside a vespera.dispatch span with mode (bytes/async/direct/streaming/bidirectional), method, path (never the query string), app, status, duration_ms and panicked; synthesised error responses emit WARN events (400 malformed wire, 413 size limit, 431 too many headers, 503 runtime shut down/overloaded, 504 deadline, other 4xx) or ERROR events (engine 5xx), and a panic unwinding out of a dispatch sets panicked=true and emits an ERROR event. Cron diagnostics (job panic, overlap skip, unschedulable job, scheduler thread failure) become tracing events on target vespera::cron instead of eprintln!. Off by default: no tracing dependency and no instrumentation code in default builds.
